items.name: Critical rating per 1% chance
items.notes: Displayed crit % already includes rating. Extra rating / 219 = extra crit %. UESP Online:Weapon Critical (effect) / Spell Critical (effect) give crit% = 10 + 100 × rating / 21912 at CP160, i.e. 219.12 rating per 1%; 219 itself is not stated, so this stays unverified until an in-game check.

items.name: Target resistance per 1% mitigation
items.notes: mitigation% = max(0, resist - pen) / 660, not R/(R+660). Caps at mitigation_cap. UESP Online:Spell Resistance / Physical Resistance state 33,000 resistance = 50% (implies 660 per 1%), but Online:Penetration says 18,200 armor resists 36.4% (implies 500 per 1%). Pages disagree and 660 is not stated; check in game.

items.name: PvE resistance mitigation cap
items.notes: 50% incoming damage reduction from resistance. 33000 resist at 660 per 1%. Cited: Online:Spell Resistance and Online:Physical Resistance — caps at 33,000 for players, reducing damage taken by 50%.

items.name: Critical damage cap
items.notes: Total crit damage including the 50% base (1.5x). Bonus crit damage caps at +75%. docs/formulas.md is wrong where it says there is no cap. Cited: Online:Critical Damage — base 50%, capped at 125%.

items.name: Max resource per 1 Weapon or Spell Damage
items.notes: 1 Weapon/Spell Damage ≈ 10.5 of the matching max resource (U33+ hybrid). No UESP page states 10.5 (searched Spell Damage, Weapon Damage, Attributes and full-text search). Check in game: tooltip damage per 1 Spell Damage vs per 10.5 Max Magicka.

items.name: Standard PvE dummy resistance
items.notes: Target resist for 6M / 21M dummy and most PvE ranking. Overpenetration above this is wasted. Cited: Online:Build Editor — default target resistance for most vet dungeon bosses is 18200 (Online:Penetration also uses 18,200 NPC armor).

items.name: Armor glyph value on small pieces
items.notes: Full glyph on head/chest/legs; 40% on shoulders/hands/waist/feet (e.g. Stamina 868 vs 347). Cited: Online:Glyph of Stamina (also Health/Magicka) — shoulder, hand, belt and foot armor receive 40% of the benefit.

items.name: Set pieces from a two-handed weapon
items.notes: Bow, staff, and 2H count as 2 set pieces. Only the active-bar weapons count. Cited: Online:Patch/4.0.0 — Two Handed, Bow, Destruction Staff and Restoration Staff weapons count for two pieces towards any item set bonus.
